title: rookies
def: rookies: first big-five league season (Understat, 2015-16 on). prospect FV = the soccer prospects board (U22) where the player was graded.
views: SVAR = SV x 90s played: season total in goals (GAR scale)

SV (season value): this season's goals over replacement a 90, from this season alone (GAR's weights on its inputs with a one-season xG plus-minus, plus finishing and keeper saves shrunk by split-half reliability)
